t: A dual-band TI radio chip with a strong amplifier for long-range wireless links.
steps: Buy a LAUNCHXL-CC1352P-2 LaunchPad from a distributor such as DigiKey.
Download the CC1352P coordinator firmware from the Koenkk Z-Stack firmware page.
Install TI Uniflash or another flashing tool on your computer.
Plug the LaunchPad in over micro-USB and flash the firmware.
Plug the LaunchPad into the computer running Home Assistant or Zigbee2MQTT.
Add it as your Zigbee coordinator in the app settings.
Pair your first Zigbee sensor or bulb and watch it appear on the dashboard.
meta: Open Board. From $8.20. A few stores.
